name: @openlance/aios-tool-engine
description: Phase 4 Stage 5 Tool Engine: the Runtime's operational tool subsystem, the operational realization of the frozen Tools namespace. It prepares a validated, governed tool execution over provided tools (register, discover, select, resolve capability inheritance, validate, normalize, prepare), driving the frozen @openlance/aios-tools model, and produces a validated ToolResponse. It consumes only the frozen tools model and the substrate, depends on no operational service (it never reaches into a provider or prompt engine and never composes a tool with a provider), never carries out a tool interaction, and contains no vendor knowledge or SDK (ADR-0039).
